Mutation proof (required observation): with app.UseMultiTenant() and its now-unused extension using temporarily removed, dotnet test tests/integration/Billing.IntegrationTests/Billing.IntegrationTests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~ForeignTenantInvoice_IsNotFound returned exit 0 and "Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Skipped: 0, Total: 1". After restoration, the same command returned exit 0 and "Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 1, Skipped: 0, Total: 1". Therefore the prescribed mutation did NOT return the requested HTTP 200; this is a reproducible failed expected-mutation proof, escalated to the coordinator, not silently represented as success.
Supporting proof: Order.IntegrationTests.CreateOrderTests.GetOrder_ForeignTenantClaimAndHeader_IsNotFound exercises GET /orders/{id} through the real HTTP path and passed in the fresh 23/23 Order integration project.
Tenantless-path proof: ReservationExpirySweepService.DiscoverTenantIdsAsync creates a fresh scope without setting IMultiTenantContext, then InventoryDbContextBase.FindTenantsWithExpiredReservationsAsync uses only IgnoreQueryFilters([Constants.TenantToken]) to discover distinct owners. ReservationExpirySweepService then creates a separate scope per returned tenant, calls SetTenantContext, and invokes ExpireHeldReservationsCommand(tenantId); ExpiredHeldReservationsSpec also predicates TenantId == tenantId. This confirms tenantless discovery is not silently scoped to one tenant and mutation is per established tenant.

implementation-result.remaining-risks: The artifact outcome is failed solely because acceptance required the UseMultiTenant or claim-strategy mutation to expose ForeignTenantInvoice as HTTP 200, but the prescribed UseMultiTenant mutation remained green. The evidence points to TenantMessageBusMiddleware stamping the signed claim onto IMessageBus and TenantPropagationMiddleware establishing the Finbuckle context from the Wolverine envelope; coordinator direction is required before an alternate mutation is authorized. The skipped Billing TenantCollidingOrderIds test remains intentionally deferred to issue #577, with its in-test skip comment preserved.
